description: Angular component for math function autocomplete in a rule node configuration, including form handling, filtering, and display logic.

classes.name: MathFunctionAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing an autocomplete input for selecting math functions, with filtering and form control integration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets up the filtered options observable based on input value changes.

methods.name: _filter
methods.description: Filters available math functions based on search text.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: mathFunctionDisplayFn
methods.description: Returns a display string for a given MathFunction value.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current value of the component.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change if value differs.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating validation if needed.
